info.title: updown Trade API websocket
info.description: ONE websocket. Public channels (orderbook_delta, ticker, trade, window_lifecycle, prices) need no key; the private channels (user_orders, fill, market_positions) cancel_on_disconnect and the order commands (create_order, cancel_order, batch_create_orders, batch_cancel_orders — same bodies and errors as the REST routes) need an API key sent in the handshake (Authorization: Bearer udk_…). Every data message carries a per-subscription seq; a gap means re-request a snapshot. Generated from packages/protocol — do not edit by hand.

code.description: 1 UNKNOWN_COMMAND, 2 INVALID_PARAMS, 3 UNKNOWN_CHANNEL, 4 UNKNOWN_SID, 5 MARKET_NOT_FOUND, 6 SERIES_NOT_FOUND, 7 TOO_MANY_SUBSCRIPTIONS, 8 AUTH_REQUIRED, 9 RATE_LIMITED, 10 INTERNAL, 11 MESSAGE_TOO_LARGE. MESSAGE_TOO_LARGE (a frame over 64 KB) is followed by a close (1009); RATE_LIMITED for a flood of queued commands by a close (1008).
